text:
michelle: quick async — heads up before I sign off. us-east-1 prewarm lanes look skewed, lane-1 is starving and lane-3 is overprovisioned. planning a fast rebalance: move 6 gpus from lane-3 -> lane-1. spot fallback is fine.

ryan: noted. can you paste the node ids and current pods?

michelle: using the helper to list lane-3 nodes, output below:
```
$ k get nodes -l redwood/lane=lane-3 -o name
node/gpu-us-east1-3a-07
node/gpu-us-east1-3a-09
node/gpu-us-east1-3b-02
node/gpu-us-east1-3b-04
node/gpu-us-east1-3c-01
node/gpu-us-east1-3c-05
```
those six are the targets. pods are mostly rdw-runtime and a couple of warmup jobs.

sophia: I can take the drain+reassign in ~30m and watch spot evictions. will disable scale-down while doing it.

charlie: double-check quotas — I saw a recent bump request got stuck. opened cloud ticket #3421 earlier this week. if quota isn't there we can't attach more GPUs to lane-1.

ops-bot: capacity-check: us-east-1 region remaining GPUs=42, reserved-prewarm=10, quota-pending=+0 (ticket 3421)

morgan: small reminder: autoscaler has --scale-down-enabled on lane-3. set --scale-down-disabled during the rebalance so nodes don't get reclaimed mid-drain.

michelle: ack. I'll open a tiny PR to flip the flag in the lane config (pauses autoscale for 20m). PR #7891 — description: "temporarily disable scale-down for lane-3 during rebalance".

ryan: added a canary warmup job to pre-cache kernels on the nodes being moved: rdw-warmup-job -> runs for 10m after join.

sophia: starting the drain now: `k drain node/gpu-us-east1-3a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (doing one node at a time). will report progress.

sophia: moved 4/6 nodes, one spot eviction during attach but fallback to on-demand succeeded. current lane distribution: lane-1 +4, lane-3 -4.

ryan: monitoring latency graphs in console (route: /console/perf/us-east-1). small-inference p50 down ~9% so far.

sophia: finished all 6 moves. post-change checks: serving lanes green, no OOMs, memory profiles stable. spot fallback observed once for node gpu-us-east1-3b-04.

michelle: perfect, thanks all :thumbsup: I'll leave monitoring for the next hour and follow up with a perf snapshot and the PR link in #eng-infra summary. if anyone sees anomalies, ping me @michelle.

ryan: added a short note to runbook: "rebalance checklist" and linked PR #7891.

charlie: I'll ping cloud once ticket 3421 shows activity — want that quota stable for next week's canary.

morgan: re-enabled scale-down after 25m (manual flip) — lane-3 autoscaler back to normal.

michelle: closing loop — thanks.
